reason: I already trade a few times a month on Robinhood and Public, and when I want a second opinion I just ask ChatGPT, so I don't see what a paid plan adds. A pet that invests for me on demo money is a cute toy, not something I'd move real dollars to.
objection: My broker already has free AI tools, and this one has no real money, no broker named yet and no price, so I'd be paying monthly for a middleman layer on top of what I get free.
would_change_my_mind: If it ran on real money with a broker I recognize and showed, over a few months, that the agent's rebalancing actually beat what I do on my own after the subscription cost.
